notes: The single TSQuadTree object (data of the TSQuadTree ERP resource; no per-resource copy). Filled by Game_TSQuadTreeResource_Load_Body or, when empty (0x1460bffc0 == 0), by Game_TSQuadTree_BuildFromTrackSpace. All static readers of its fields 0x1460bff88..0x1460bffc0 are network code: vehicle LoD send 0x143262840 ('%02d sent to %02d at LoD %d'), Game_Network_DeserialiseVehicle 0x14326a9c0 (VehicleProgressSync / VehicleProgressPrediction), Game_VehicleProgressSync_Update 0x143267ab0, clear 0x1430ceae0, network handlePacket 0x1432666b0 ('NETWORK-DATA/U', cmp 0x1432667da), static init 0x143349850. So in offline sessions the TSQuadTree data is loaded but not read by any found code (static; .data1 readers cannot be ruled out). 2026-11-17 engine-re. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested) | 2026-11-17 engine-re track runtime round 2, static. In-memory layout (readers 0x143262840, Game_Network_DeserialiseVehicle 0x14326a9c0, clear 0x1430ceae0): +0x00 f32 min xyz, +0x0c f32 max xyz, +0x18 f32 point radius (reset to 20.0 by the clear), +0x1c u32 point count (compared at 0x14326b25b), +0x28 points (16 bytes each), +0x30 u16 node array (16 bytes per node, node 0 = root, child[0] == 0 marks a leaf), +0x38 allocator. So point indices are u8 (0xff = none, at most 255 points), a leaf holds at most 12 one-byte indices (bytes +4..+0xf), node indices are u16. These match the stock writer (min(255, floor(L/15.1)) points, radius 20, leaf 8). The file deserialiser 0x143223aa0 -> 0x14ff401e0 -> 0x151d74cd0 is control-flow obfuscated (stack-pivot and opaque arithmetic in .data1), so what it checks while reading is still OPEN. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested)
